# Input

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/view/components/input.h`](../../../src/view/components/input.h) · Described in `data/view.json`

The window's keyboard, mouse and window state of the frame, written by Input (SDL events) and UI.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `std::optional<std::array<char, SDL_TEXTINPUTEVENT_TEXT_SIZE>>` | text typed this frame (UTF-8), consumed by UI |
| `on` | `std::bitset<Action::END_ENUM>` | held actions (FORWARD W, BACKWARD S, LEFT A, RIGHT D, PAUSE P, MENU M, DEBUG K, BACKSPACE, TAB, ROTATE_LEFT/RIGHT arrows, ANGLE_UP/DOWN arrows, UP Space, DOWN LCtrl, SPRINT LShift, VR_RIG R, INTERACT E, CURSOR LAlt) and the events RESIZE, EXIT (Escape / window closed); some are one-shot flags cleared by their consumer (PAUSE, VR_RIG, CURSOR, EXIT) |
| `mousePos` | `glm::ivec2` | cursor in window pixels, updated while focused |
| `mouseWheel` | `glm::ivec2` | wheel notches of the last wheel event this frame |
| `mouseDelta` | `glm::ivec2` | relative mouse motion this frame |
| `screenSize` | `glm::ivec2` | window size in pixels |
| `mouseLeft / mouseRight / mouseMiddle` | `bool` | raw button state |
| `leftDown / rightDown / middleDown` | `bool` | button state for the scene: false while ImGui wants the mouse (UI) |
| `leftClick / rightClick / middleClick` | `bool` | pressed this frame, cleared by UI while ImGui wants the mouse |
| `focused` | `bool` | the window has the keyboard focus |
| `window_showing` | `bool` | false while minimised |

## Notes

Emplaced by InputSys's constructor (so before any preinit); Game::start reads Input::EXIT to end the loop. CameraWalk sets EXIT at the end of a walk with exit. Not the player components (MouseKeyboardInput reads it for the DesktopView player).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: BoxThrower, ClassicRender, DesktopRoller. Written by: CameraWalk, DebugMenu, Game, Input, MouseKeyboardInput, PlayerControl, Time, UI. Created by: Input. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BoxThrower](../systems/BoxThrower.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | leftClick (UI clears it while ImGui wants the mouse) |
| [CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md) | system | Host | **write** | tick | sets Input::EXIT at the end of the walk with "exit": the process ends |
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **write** | tick | "Move play area to camera" sets Input::VR_RIG (PlayerControl acts on it) |
| [DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (desktopCommand) | FORWARD / BACKWARD / LEFT / RIGHT / SPRINT |
| [Input](../systems/Input.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | constructor (emplace), tick | clears the per-frame clicks, wheel and motion, then sets the action bits, buttons, motion, text, focus, screen size and mouse position |
| [MouseKeyboardInput](../systems/MouseKeyboardInput.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | the action bits, mouseDelta, mouseLeft / mouseRight, wheel; clears Input::CURSOR once used |
| [PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | rightDown, mouseDelta, mouseWheel, the movement actions; clears Input::VR_RIG once used |
| [Time](../systems/Time.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | reads Input::PAUSE and clears it once used; screenSize places the window |
| [UI](../systems/UI.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | reads buttons, text, keys, mouse position, screen size; consumes text; clears leftClick/rightClick/middleClick and *Down when ImGui wants the mouse, else copies mouse* into *Down |
| [ClassicRender](../systems/service-ClassicRender.md) | service | Host | **read** | prepare | window_showing: nothing is acquired or drawn for a minimized window. |
| [Game](../systems/service-Game.md) | service | Host | **readwrite** | frame loop | on[EXIT] read and cleared |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[BoxThrower](../systems/BoxThrower.md)**
  - A new entity with a dynamic Jolt body per click, never destroyed; colours cycle from a function-static counter.
- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[ClassicRender](../systems/service-ClassicRender.md)**
  - GPU: command and descriptor pools, mapped uniform buffers, semaphores, query pool, capture buffer; records the desktop command buffer; acquires and presents swapchain images.
  - Log: gpu_times warnings and pass times every 300 frames and at each capture.
  - Profiler: CPU and GPU zones per pass (<pass> (desktop)), Sun rays / Composite (desktop).
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Game](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Reads and writes ./config.7.json; reads resources/graphics.json and the scene files.
  - Creates the Renderer (Vulkan, SDL window, OpenXR).
  - Creates the host thread pool (tf::Executor).
  - Logs unknown arguments, ignored values, the graphics level and scene errors.
- **[Input](../systems/Input.md)**
  - Drains SDL's event queue every frame (SDL_PollEvent): no other system may poll it, and the capture's scripted events pushed by Capture::beginFrame are read here.
  - Reads the window size (SDL_GetWindowSize) and, while focused, the cursor position (SDL_GetMouseState).
  - Escape or closing the window sets Input::EXIT, which ends the main loop of Game::start.
- **[MouseKeyboardInput](../systems/MouseKeyboardInput.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode on while captured (every tick); ImGui's NoMouse config flag set while captured; both undone in finish.
- **[PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode on while the right mouse button is held, off otherwise (not touched while a DesktopView player exists).
  - The fly speed (30 m/s, x1.25 / x0.8 a wheel notch, 1 to 2000) is a function-static shared by every instance.
- **[Time](../systems/Time.md)**
  - Two ImGui windows: "Time" (date, speed radio buttons 0/1/3/10/50) at the top right, and "Frame time" (ms, fps).
- **[UI](../systems/UI.md)**
  - Creates the ImGui context (dark style) in its constructor when the renderer's UI pass has not made it yet.
  - Creates eight SDL system cursors in its constructor (never set nor freed).
  - Calls ImGui::NewFrame every tick: every system that draws an ImGui window must come after it in the frame; the UI pass renders the frame.
